description.en: Item-level aggregates recomputed from the original response workbooks; no individual responses are included.

source_documents.file: 数据采集与分析/生产数据/Results and discussion-生产者-CN.docx

methodology.aggregation: Each item is summarized separately. No dimension index is created and no reverse coding is applied.
methodology.validity_rule: Accept only finite integer numeric values from 1 to 5. Blank values and other codes are excluded separately for each item; do not delete whole respondents from all questions.
methodology.count_validation: Each 1–5 distribution sums to valid_n; valid_n + missing_n + invalid_n equals sample_n.
methodology.source_privacy: Only aggregate counts and statistics are included; no response rows, respondent identifiers or demographics are exported.

text.en: The Chinese C2 and C4 text is a verifiable item summary from the analysis document, not an invented verbatim questionnaire statement.

limitations.zh: 这些比例描述本次问卷样本，不代表所有市集或城市人群。
limitations.en: These shares describe the surveyed sample, not all markets or city populations.

limitations.zh: 消费者与商户回答不同陈述，不能把两侧题目当作同一量表直接比较高低。
limitations.en: Consumers and merchants answered different statements; their item scores are not directly comparable measures.

limitations.zh: 均值仅用于描述有序的1–5回答；同意比例是选择4或5的比例，不是实际购买或调价发生率。
limitations.en: Means describe ordered 1–5 responses. Agreement is the share selecting 4 or 5, not an observed purchase or repricing rate.

limitations.zh: 自陈横截面数据只能呈现样本中的回答分布，不能证明因果关系或市场均衡。
limitations.en: Self-reported cross-sectional responses describe sample distributions and do not establish causation or market equilibrium.

limitations.zh: 本次只汇总预先选定的10个单题，未据此验证完整量表或创建维度指数。
limitations.en: This summary covers ten selected individual items; it neither validates the full instrument nor creates dimension indices.
